children: Raiffeisen Bank International's results should be well-received after a guidance upgrade, Keefe, Bruyette and Woods' Ben Maher and Hugo Cruz write. The Austrian bank reported higher-than-expected earnings driven by net interest income and lower than expected risk costs, KBW says. The bank's shares have outperformed its peers over the last months, but the results should be well-received by investors anyway, the analysts say. The results were "good" as the bank raises its guidance for net interest income and loan growth, the analysts add. (michael.hennessey@wsj.com)
